row-side-padding.why: an email row's side padding: 0.2 wrote it outside the content width, so in a window wider than the content but narrower than the content plus those sides the email scrolled sideways or sat off centre; the new engine keeps the content centred at its width with no sideways scroll. Accepted as a fix; pinned by the react package's end-to-end gate (row-side-padding)

long-words.why: a word too long for its column (a large figure such as 99.99% or 2.4M): 0.2 let it run out of its column on a page; the new engine wraps it inside the column. Accepted as a fix; pinned by the exporters' Chromium test that breaks a word too long for its column
